title: The moving branch is the unique weak-reward global minimizer over every negative-kurtosis symmetric three-point seed

global_branch.parameter_space: The closed family p in [1/3,1] has support bounded by sqrt(3); negative fourth cumulant is 1/3<p<=1.
global_branch.strong_channel_exclusion: For fixed t>0 every member is non-Gaussian after convolution and has positive relative Fisher; separated discrete components prevent t->1 minimizers.
global_branch.vanishing_defect_exclusion: At p=1/3, u=0 but kappa_6=-6; the positive kappa_6^2 t^6/120 term makes every p->1/3 branch larger than the interior p_* branch at its first distinguishing scale.
global_branch.interior_selection: Away from p_*, K1702's nonnegative cubic square is strict; every global minimizer therefore converges to p_*.
global_branch.uniqueness: The positive scaled Hessian at p_* and the K1707 implicit branch give a unique global branch and one minimizer for every sufficiently small positive reward.

scope_guard: Completeness refers only to the symmetric three-point family; other bounded seeds with vanishing defect or support changing with coupling remain outside the theorem.
